description: Consume units of a user's purchased product from the backoffice, for support fixes. It only SPENDS units and moves NO money — it is not a refund. Refunds are made in Stripe, from the dashboard that neblla_payments_account dashboard_link opens. It does not resolve a missing-delivery claim, and it takes away what little they have. Atomic: fails with insufficient_amount if the user has fewer units. The user's app gets a live `purchase` event.
name: neblla_consume_purchase
title: Consume purchase
